segments.en:
And so on — as elaborated in the discourse.

Lamnatzeiach mizmor l'Dovid ashrei — and so on — [Psalms 41]: composed of three languages — nitzuach — mizmor — ashrei.

segments.he: מאמר זה נאמר בתחלת חורף תקס"ג ויש בזה סיפור שלם ויבואר קצת במקום אחר:
segments.en: And ends with the language of berachah: "baruch Haveye'ah [blessed is Haveye'ah]." And so on. And it also contains several other languages alluding to the rectification of this sin — as is understood.
